import time
from mapping import map_all
VALUES = [5, 3, 7, 1, 6, 0, 4, 2]
def f(i):
    time.sleep((8 - i) * 0.02)
    return VALUES[i]
try:
    got = map_all(f, range(8))
    empty = map_all(f, [])
except Exception as e:
    raise AssertionError(repr(e))
assert got == VALUES, got
assert empty == [], empty

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor, as_completed


def map_all(fn, items, workers=8):
    """fn(item) for every item, computed on a thread pool, in the order of items."""
    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        futures = [pool.submit(fn, item) for item in items]
        return [f.result() for f in as_completed(futures)]

from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor


def map_all(fn, items, workers=8):
    """fn(item) for every item, computed on a thread pool, in the order of items."""
    items = list(items)
    out = [None] * len(items)

    def one(i, item):
        out[i] = fn(item)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=workers) as pool:
        for i, item in enumerate(items):
            pool.submit(one, i, item)
    return out
